sources.entry: WiFi Lens - Native Wi-Fi analyzer and network diagnostics app with real-time spectrum scanning and BLE device tracking.

summary.one_liner: WiFi Lens is an open-source native macOS Wi-Fi analyzer that scans nearby networks, shows channel congestion, runs network diagnostics, and tracks BLE devices, with a commercial Pro edition adding monitoring and history.
summary.what_it_does: The open-source edition scans nearby Wi-Fi networks across 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz bands and shows spectrum occupancy charts and congestion scores with regional channel recommendations. It displays network details such as PHY generation, channel width, 802.11k/r/v, WPA3, and connection info (IP, gateway, DNS, MAC, Tx rate). It includes a roaming test for AP handoffs, a per-band channel heatmap, and AP Radar, which tracks a selected AP using RSSI guidance with optional audio. A BLE scanner covers Bluetooth LE discovery, RSSI analysis, and tracking. An embedded MCP HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 lets local AI tools read Wi-Fi data, and charts can be exported as PNG or CSV. A Network Self-Check (Preview) runs path, DNS, HTTPS, and proxy reachability checks.
use_cases: Diagnose Wi-Fi congestion and pick a less crowded channel
Inspect nearby networks' security and PHY capabilities
Check roaming handoffs between access points
Find a better spot for a router using RSSI tracking
Connect an AI assistant to local Wi-Fi data
Scan and track nearby Bluetooth LE devices
how_to_run: Download the latest release from GitHub Releases
brew tap ShiinaLabs/apps && brew install --cask ShiinaLabs/apps/wifi-lens
notable: Embedded MCP server lets AI assistants like Claude Desktop or Codex query live local Wi-Fi data
BLE scanner included in the open-source edition
Local-first with no telemetry; MCP binds only to 127.0.0.1
Forked from tiny-wifi-analyzer with MAC vendor data from IEEE
Localized into English, German, Spanish, Japanese, and Chinese
caveats: Requires macOS 14.6 or later and Location Services enabled to read SSID names
Continuous monitoring, event history, statistics, insights, spectrum recording, and menu bar monitoring are only in the paid Pro edition (Mac App Store)
